unit: earliest datable citation per sense division, in sense order

verdict.text: WITHDRAWN — the claim that PD's chronological sense ordering is distinctive is withdrawn: PWG, MW fail(s) the pre-registered floor (worst Δτ = -0.082, Holm p = 1.0000 against a floor of +0.10); the tendency is shared with non-historical dictionaries and the A68 footnote must say so.
